scenarios.description: EXPERIMENTAL live: claude-sonnet-5-5 discovery → topic-consolidation-v3 consolidation → jev-latest assignment.

expected.outcome: ideal; any deviation is a measurement of the real providers, not a harness failure

topics.name: range per charge
topics.description: Real-world distance per charge versus claimed range, effects of terrain, cold, rider weight and assist mode, and accuracy of the range or battery gauge.

topics.name: motor and assist behaviour
topics.description: Feel and power of the motor and assist: smoothness, torque sensing, jerky pickup, noise, cut-off at 25 km/h, hill climbing and assist levels.

topics.name: folding and portability
topics.description: The fold mechanism, speed and ease of folding, latch and hinge quality, folded size, weight, carrying, trains and car boot storage.

topics.name: ride comfort and fit
topics.description: Comfort on the road, including bumps and vibration, tyres, suspension seatpost, saddle, handlebar and seat dimensions, and fit for different rider heights.

topics.name: charging and battery handling
topics.description: Charging time, charger design, charging port, removable battery convenience, spare packs and battery degradation over time.

topics.name: braking performance
topics.description: How the brakes perform: stopping power, fade, squeal, sponginess, rubbing, lever reach, wet-weather braking and pad compatibility.

topics.name: price and value
topics.description: Whether the cost is justified, comparisons to other bikes and alternatives, discounts, resale value and accessory pricing.

topics.name: app electronics and reliability
topics.description: The companion app, display and electronics (connectivity, permissions, firmware, water resistance), plus build quality, parts failures, rust and defects.

method.providerLabel: Two-phase topics (Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 (topic-discovery-v2) → consolidation (topic-consolidation-v3) + TypeSafe jev-latest (jev-topic-a1), batches of ≤ 25)
